Tech Stack: MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js (MERN Stack) | GitHub:https://github.com/yashwanthd19/NutriTrack

-

-

-

AI-Based Flappy Bird Game

-
Implemented heuristic-based search to enable autonomous obstacle avoidance and decision-making.
-
Designed an AI agent to determine efficient movement paths in real time.
-
Built the application using Python and the Pygame library.
